orderConfirmation.subject: Order {number} is confirmed
orderConfirmation.title: Thank you for your order
orderConfirmation.intro: Your payment for order {number} was received and the work is yours. We will let you know when it ships or is ready for pickup.
orderConfirmation.disclosureNote: A printed copy of the disclosure document is also included with the work.
orderConfirmation.cancelLink: Cancel the purchase with the online form

cancellationAck.subject: We received your cancellation notice {number}
cancellationAck.title: Your cancellation notice was received
cancellationAck.intro: We received your cancellation notice on {date} (Israel time). This is your acknowledgement; please keep it.
cancellationAck.next1: We will review the notice and get back to you. Any refund will be made no later than {date}.
cancellationAck.next2: If the work has already reached you, we will send instructions for returning it.
cancellationAck.next3: There is no need to send another notice. If you do, it will be received and recorded as well.

painterCancellation.subject: New cancellation notice {number}
painterCancellation.title: A cancellation notice was received
painterCancellation.intro: A cancellation notice ({channel}) was received on {date}.
painterCancellation.duplicate: This may be a duplicate of an open notice for the same order.
painterCancellation.unmatched: The notice was not matched to an order automatically. Match it on the cancellations screen.
painterCancellation.deadline: The refund is due by {date} (14 days from the notice).
painterCancellation.open: Open the notice in the admin

returnInstructions.subject: Return instructions – order {number}
returnInstructions.title: Cancellation accepted – how to return the work
returnInstructions.intro: We accepted cancellation notice {cancellation} for order {number}.
returnInstructions.pack: Please pack the work in its original packaging or similar protective packaging, with nothing touching the paint surface, and send it with tracking. Reply to this email with the tracking number.
returnInstructions.refund: Refund amount: {amount}. The refund goes back to the original payment method.
returnInstructions.contact: Reply to this email to arrange a collection or with any question.

kinds.REFUND_DUE_SOON: A cancellation refund is close to its legal deadline
kinds.REFUND_OVERDUE: A cancellation refund is past its legal deadline
kinds.UNSHIPPED_LATE: A paid order was not shipped on time
kinds.EXPORT_DECLARATION_PENDING: An export declaration has been pending for more than 7 days
kinds.PAYMENT_REVIEW_LONG: A payment has been under review for more than 24 hours
kinds.TURNOVER_CEILING: Yearly turnover is close to the VAT-exempt ceiling
kinds.PAYMENT_NEEDS_REFUND: A received payment needs a refund
